data.name: Faisal
data.gender_notes: Faisal is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ف-ص-ل (f-ṣ-l), 'to decide, separate'. Fayṣal means 'decisive'. Its root is ف-ص-ل (f-ṣ-l). A common Muslim given name. Faisal is a Arabic name meaning “Decisive; judge; arbiter”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Faisal expresses “Decisive; judge; arbiter”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ف-ص-ل (f-ṣ-l), 'to decide, separate'. Fayṣal means 'decisive'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faisal total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
